rules.title: Valid document
rules.why: A Plan must parse as YAML and have a spec mapping, or the controller can't admit it.
rules.fix: Fix the YAML syntax; ensure top-level apiVersion/kind/metadata/spec are present and spec is a mapping.

rules.title: apiVersion
rules.why: Only agent.leartech.io/v1alpha1 is served by the platform CRD.

rules.title: kind
rules.why: The catalog accepts only Plan and PlanTemplate.
rules.fix: Set kind to Plan or PlanTemplate.

rules.title: Name shape
rules.why: metadata.name becomes a DNS-1123 label and part of the child AgentRun name; >58 chars risks the 63-byte pod-label cap.
rules.fix: Use a lowercase DNS-1123 name (letters, digits, hyphens) of at most 58 characters.

rules.title: Hold-by-default
rules.why: A catalog Plan is a PROPOSAL — it must not execute on merge. Execution is a separate, human-gated promote/unpause.
rules.fix: Set spec.paused: true on every Plan.

rules.title: Step shape
rules.why: Each step is either a template include (use:) or a concrete step; a concrete non-fan-in step needs a kind and an agentType.
rules.fix: Give the step a name; for a concrete step set kind to pr|apply|check and set agentType; or make it a use:/fanIn step.

rules.title: Unique step names
rules.why: Step names must be unique — they compute the child AgentRun name and dependsOn edges.
rules.fix: Rename duplicate steps so every step name is unique.

rules.title: dependsOn resolves
rules.why: A dependsOn that names no declared step leaves the step permanently blocked.
rules.fix: Point dependsOn at existing step names, or remove the dangling entry.

rules.title: Template shape
rules.why: A PlanTemplate declares params and steps; its steps are concrete (kind+agentType) and must not nest use: (expansion is depth-1).
rules.fix: Give the template params + steps; make each step concrete (kind+agentType) with no nested use:.

rules.title: No laptop paths
rules.why: A Plan runs in a K8s Job with only the target repo checked out — laptop/absolute paths never resolve.
rules.fix: Reference only repo-committed or defined-store artifacts; remove /Users/, /home/, or ~/ paths.

rules.title: No cycle
rules.why: A dependsOn cycle makes the DAG un-runnable; the controller marks the Plan Failed.
rules.fix: Break the cycle so the dependsOn graph is acyclic.

rules.title: No self-dependency
rules.why: A step depending on itself (via dependsOn or triggeredWhen) can never start.

rules.title: Fan-in shape
rules.why: A fanIn step is a no-agent gate: it must fan in from >=1 dependsOn and assert >=1 fanInValidate path; a non-fan-in step must not set fanInValidate.
rules.fix: For fanIn: true add dependsOn + fanInValidate; otherwise remove fanInValidate.

rules.title: use-step fields
rules.why: A use: step must not smuggle runtime fields — the template supplies them; expansion hard-fails otherwise.
rules.fix: On a use: step keep only name, use, with, dependsOn (and triggeredWhen); remove agentType/inputs/repo/budgetIter/hold/fanIn/fanInValidate.

rules.title: Template resolvable
rules.why: A use: references a PlanTemplate; if it isn't in this PR it must already exist on the target cluster.
rules.fix: Co-submit the referenced template, or confirm it is deployed on the cluster.

rules.title: Required params
rules.why: A template param marked required must be supplied, or expansion fails.
rules.fix: Add the missing param(s) to the use-step's with: block.

rules.title: triggeredWhen
rules.why: triggeredWhen must name a declared step and a valid phase, or the trigger never fires.
rules.fix: Point triggeredWhen.step at an existing step and set phase to Running|AwaitingReview|AwaitingApproval|Succeeded.

rules.title: Expanded name length
rules.why: An over-long expanded child name (<plan>-<useStep>-<tmplStep>) is hash-truncated by the controller — it still runs but the name is unreadable.
rules.fix: Shorten the plan, use-step, or template step names to keep the expanded name under 57 chars.

rules.title: Test coherence
rules.why: test.directed vocabulary is kind-specific; a mismatch is a silent no-op, and a directive without spec.test is ignored.
rules.fix: Match test.directed to the step kind (pr→merged|closed_unmerged|opened, check→pass|fail, apply→succeed|error) and set spec.test: true.
